name: Haydn at Palácio da Bolsa
description: Experience classical brilliance in an architectural masterpiece. Soloists from the Orquestra Sinfónica perform Haydn's profound "Seven Last Words" in the magnificent setting of the Stock Exchange Palace.
longDescription:
On October 12, 2026, the Palácio da Bolsa hosts an evening of classical music featuring soloists from the Orquestra Sinfónica. The program centers on Joseph Haydn's "The Seven Last Words of Christ on the Cross," a profound work originally composed for orchestra, choir, and soloists, later adapted by Haydn himself for string quartet. This performance will feature the string quartet arrangement, allowing for an intimate interpretation of the piece's emotional depth and intricate counterpoint.

Attendees will experience a performance within the historic grandeur of the Palácio da Bolsa, a 19th-century neoclassical building. The setting provides a backdrop for the contemplative nature of Haydn's composition. The concert is designed for an audience interested in classical chamber music and the works of the Classical era. The duration of the performance is expected to be approximately 60-75 minutes, without an intermission.

Tickets for this event are required for entry. The Palácio da Bolsa is located in the historic centre of Porto, within walking distance of the Ribeira district. It is accessible via public transport, with the São Bento metro station approximately a 10-minute walk away, and various bus routes serving the area.
